title: ‘2 Valid IDs’ earns nearly P15 million at the box office
summary: The movie "2 Valid IDs" starring Marietta "Pokwang" Subong, Joey Marquez, Meryll Soriano, and Zaijian Jaranilla, has earned nearly ₱15 million at the box office.
